diagnostics.message: delete_http_settings removes an HTTP settings object that can still be referenced by request routing rules; delete_request_routing_rule should run first. Its current depends_on list does not include delete_http_settings.

delete_url_path_map removes a path map that may still contain URL path rules; delete_url_path_rule should run before deleting the map. The existing dependency is in the opposite direction (delete_url_path_rule depends on delete_url_path_map).

delete_probe removes a probe that HTTP settings may reference, but delete_http_settings has no dependency on delete_probe. The set-side ordering already indicates HTTP settings are downstream of probes.
